title: Finiteness and Dedekind-psi cardinality of Gamma0 cosets
statement: For every nonzero natural number N, let G=SL₂(ℤ), let Γ₀(N) consist of the matrices whose bottom-left entry is zero modulo N, and let Q=G/Γ₀(N) be the left-coset space. Then Q is finite and |Q|=∑_{d∣N, d squarefree}N/d, namely ModularCurve.dedekindPsi N.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], let Q := (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N; Finite Q ∧ Nat.card Q = ModularCurve.dedekindPsi N
